# shipd_project (Resource)

A shipd project. Destroy archives the project; recovery and slug reservation last seven days. Use lifecycle.prevent_destroy to protect important projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_project" "app" {
  name = "My application"
  slug = "my-application"
}

output "project_id" {
  value = shipd_project.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project display name.
- `slug` (String) Project slug; at least three characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable project ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns this project.
- `version` (Number) API version used for optimistic concurrency checks.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_project.app PROJECT_ID
```
